## Follow-up repair status (review R1-R8; not normative authority)
- P4 narrowed to ACK only; ERR-driven K6 count failures at row e are mixed_same_edge.
- A membership death at row e reclassified as mixed is not a refutation: tags of histories alive at the row start are flushed as open valid-prefix unknowns with original tag rows; discarded_epoch_evidence only holds deaths wholly before e.
- Exhaustion records disclose snapshot point and actual vs projected hypothesis count; death records disclose omitted dying-row tags per event.
- Scope accounting: counts.subobligation_activations and counts.clause_scope (units: K1 reset rows; K2 master held/accepted strobes and slave acceptances; K3 slave acceptances; K4 slave acceptances with defined projection, split count_projection vs candidate_consumption; K6 master responses with CYC high, split count_bound vs attribution; K7 master ACKs; K8 master responses; K9 CYC 1->0; K10 slave strobe rows and ACK&ERR rows; K12 batch end; K13 responses with CYC low). Raw activations are exposure, not coverage.
- Still open: K5, C1-C4, F1-F8, timeout/cancellation bounds, both_interfaces_pending, rule 3.05 sub-row reset.

## Proposed decisions for fresh independent review (not normative authority)

patches.before: Undefined i_sdata on a slave ACK: env violation only if some history binds it to a live read (hypothesis-dependent; integer drivers cannot emit None).
patches.after: Undefined i_sdata on a slave ACK: superseded by the association-free pin FIFO-head rule above (integer drivers cannot emit None).

rationale: R1/R2: the K6 count failure is pin-only for ACKs because ACKs never use HR. For ERRs it is non-pin, because the non-HR classification reads row-e inputs. The ACK selftest now expects dut_violation. Added an ERR clean baseline (dut_violation) and an ERR boundary case (input_or_scope_invalid) matching the supplied companions. Ordinary ERR detection on valid traces is unchanged.

R3: boundary() moves the disclosures of a mixed row-e death into open unknowns at their original tag rows. The refuted wording is removed and ownership is withheld. New test mixed_death_keeps_prefix_tag_open covers this.
R4: exhaust() records the snapshot point and the actual versus projected hypothesis counts. Death records carry a per-event dying_row_tags disclosure.
R5: per-sub-obligation checked, suspended and post-death counts are added, with association-free parts split out. Exposure is not reported as coverage.

R7 caveat: the undefined-read rule now uses the pin-derived per-slave FIFO (S['sfq'] stores the WE observed at slave acceptance). It is genuinely independent of hypotheses and is tested, including the orphan case.
R8: documents synced. P4 and the undefined-read text are revised and the obsolete blocker wording is removed. Gaps that remain open are listed.
contract_decisions: Accepted P4 for ACK only. ERR-driven K6 count failures at row e are mixed_same_edge.
A mixed death at row e is never treated as a refutation. Its prefix tags remain open unknowns.
Undefined read data on a slave ACK is an env violation via the public FIFO head. This deliberately also covers orphan reads. It tightens env classification only, and integer drivers cannot emit None.
Activation counters report exposure and carry no cover or proof claim.
No freeze, replay or B/C is authorized. The full controls and a new review are still required.
